output.answer: CDW Corporation's annual revenue (Net sales) for fiscal year 2025, the most recently completed fiscal year, was $22,424 million (~$22.4 billion), up 6.8 percent from $20,999 million in 2024, per CDW's fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 earnings release (February 4, 2026) and its Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 ($22,424.1 million). Revenue has continued to grow into 2026: Q3 2026 net sales were $6,755 million, up 17.7 percent year over year. CDW's fiscal year runs on a calendar-year basis, so FY2026 results will not be finalized until early 2027.
caveats: Annual revenue for fiscal year 2026 is not yet available; the figure above covers the year ended December 31, 2025. Quarterly 2026 results (Q3 2026 net sales of $6,755 million, +17.7% YoY) suggest full-year 2026 revenue will be materially higher, but no full-year 2026 number exists yet.
CDW reports revenue as 'Net sales,' which includes revenue recorded on a net basis for certain software and services (netted-down revenue), so its reported total differs from gross billings.
